title: Ethotechnics: an open framework for the operational accountability of high-stakes automated systems
description:
Ethotechnics publishes proposed standards, mechanisms, and diagnostics that treat evidence, authorization, challenge, reconsideration, correction, and escalation as explicit states of a deployed system rather than as policy commitments about it.

The corpus includes the Temporal Bill of Rights (STD-01), the Contestability and Recourse Standard (STD-02), the Human Impact Safety Case (STD-06), the Revisable Delegation Record (STD-07), Delegation (STD-08), Agent Chains (STD-09), a minimum viable contestability baseline (MVC-01), an institutional failure postmortem template (PM-01), a casebook of public failures scored against the standards, and crosswalks to existing governance regimes including ISO/IEC 42001.

Each archived release is a snapshot of the source of https://ethotechnics.org. The release notes list the dated changes since the previous release.
